svg.title: ZKRoto 0.2 - 04 export shot folder and files
svg.text: Export (Ctrl+E) - the shot folder and what each file holds
src: the clip's own angle (if ticked)
pov: yaw, eye height, distance, FOV, roll,
look at, 832 x 1216 P / L, fit margins
one image per shot and camera:
every exported frame in a grid
src = always the same name per frame (the clip's camera does not change);
pov = named from the camera, so a new angle gives new files and the same
angle overwrites: y yaw 0-359, h eye height cm, d distance cm, f FOV deg;
+ _r<roll> only if roll is not 0 (_rm10 = -10), + _L for Landscape.
Shot empty -> clip name. Capture (C) -> ZKRoto\capture\<clip>\ (own folder).
"points": [[x, y, vis] x 33], pixels, this camera
Sheet: every exported frame of the shot for one
camera, 33 points drawn, in frame order, frame
number under each tile; rebuilt on each Export.
